title: Metabolic balance
metaDescription: Metabolic balance, post-menopause nutrition, and inflammation support — Patricia Smith at Equilibrium in Takaka, Golden Bay, NZ.

blocks.html: After menopause — or whenever metabolism, cholesterol, inflammation, and food cravings refuse to follow “eat less, move more” — clients often need a way to ask the body what it wants to eat and what needs support.

At Equilibrium in Takaka, Patricia uses Touch for Health Kinesiology alongside Nutrition. Muscle testing can highlight food preferences the body responds to, liver and adrenal support needs, and emotional patterns tied to eating. The work is step by step: meal by meal, week by week — not a short lecture and a printout.

Clients have described calmer bodies and minds, less inflammation, better sleep and energy, and shifts that other approaches alone had not produced — including when they had already tried multiple modalities.
